validation_scope: Read-only AST/text/data comparison. No shared module, model, tokenizer, experiment, parser or test function was imported or executed.
overall: No unresolved material defect found in the final reviewed shared implementation; dynamic behavior remains untested by user instruction.

findings.original_issue: Transformers5.20 unconditionally refills None values from model.generation_config, and no longer has use_model_defaults. Merely filling non-None framework defaults did not isolate disabled min_p or other optional values.
findings.resolution: Official-profile branch temporarily supplies deepcopy(clean config) as the model fallback reference only during generate, then restores the exact previous reference in finally. Non-profile branch remains separate.

findings.original_issue: Constructing a v5 PretrainedConfig before GenerationConfig can lose legacy generation fields from raw config.json.
findings.resolution: _fresh_model_generation first uses GenerationConfig.from_model_config(raw dict), supported by5.20 including nested decoder/text_config; older object-only APIs fall back to a fresh disk-derived config object.

Only missing bos/eos/pad/decoder_start fields are completed from fresh model-config bytes, preserving explicit generation-config values and EOS lists. Missing EOS rejects generation. Missing pad materializes HF technical fallback to first EOS and records that distinct basis.
findings.boundary: Fresh-model-config completion is explicitly identified as technical/protocol fallback; it is not falsely described as an author sampling recommendation.

findings.conclusion: GenerationConfig5.20 _get_default_generation_params is a no-argument staticmethod returning a dict. Resolver call shape is correct; it fills only declared non-None generic defaults and retains disabled/optional None fields.

Five Qwen mode profiles match pinned official evidence. Qwen3 modes are explicit template kwargs; Qwen2.5 retains repetition_penalty1.1. GPT medium reasoning and neutral sampler translation are separately evidenced in registry. Gated models use fresh local config/defaults and do not invent public numeric values.

Task/stage max_new_tokens and existing audit seeds are intentionally separate from model sampler profile. Actual remaining-context reduction is recorded per event. This does not mean the Qwen3 general32768 output recommendation has been applied to every short-label task.
official_profile defaults False and only opt-in callers use clean official policy; legacy/excluded callers retain the prior branch. Source inventory is separate from manuscript row attribution.

limits: Static review cannot establish runtime success or actual gated/local checkpoint values.
